newsitem.title: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO: New Congo to host African summit on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: New Congo to host African summit on Sunday.

text.p: The Democratic Republic of the Congo said on Saturday it would host a summit on Sunday of African heads of states who have pledged support for President Laurent Kabila.
Government spokesman Raphael Ghenda said 10 heads of states were expected in the capital Kinshasa over the week-end for the gathering which would be devoted to "African cooperation".
"We are expecting Zimbabwe, Namibia, Angola, Zambia, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, Eritrea, Ethiopia and Ghana to take part in this meeting," Ghenda said.
"It will be a one-day summit and it will take place tomorrow," he added.
Kabila grabbed power in May after a seven-month military campaign that put an end to the 32-year rule of president Mobutu Sese Seko, who has fled into exile from the country formerly known as Zaire.
Kabila has pledged to reform Africa's third largest country after decades of economic mismanagement under Mobutu.
